suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Wasting CPU Cycles
suggestion.rationale: Developers constantly misapply threading to I/O-bound tasks, causing GIL contention and deadlocks. This Short directly contrasts threading overhead with AsyncIO's single-threaded event loop to capture high search traffic.
suggestion.hook_angle: Still using Python threads for network requests? You're literally throwing away CPU cycles and inviting race conditions.
